archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-identity
archetypes.rationale: Identity match, rejoin, and one-retry paths are easy to get subtly wrong.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect step-8-assessment.sh for launch-identity matching on live and completed rejoin, active-stale-identity-mismatch refusal, attempt-2 fail-closed publication, and that architectural-assessment run runs only in --bgjob-child mode. Confirm ASSESSMENT_COVERED_FINGERPRINT is launch-time only and not compared to post-run materialization. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
